name: VibeSec-Skill
title_zh: 写网页时旁边蹲着个安全审计员，每段代码都过一遍
tagline_zh: 不是写完再扫，是边写边拦。SQL 注入、XSS、越权，在你敲下回车前就指出问题，省掉事后返工和半夜应急。
tagline_en: Not scan-after-write, but catch-as-you-code. SQLi, XSS, broken access—flagged before you hit enter, saving rework.
desc_en: This skill helps Claude write secure web applications. Use this when working on any web application or when a user requests a scan or audit to ensure security best practices are followed.
why_zh: 它把安全审查嵌进编码流程本身，不是事后报告。每段新代码都即时对照 OWASP 模式。
why_en: It embeds security review into the coding flow itself—not a post-mortem report. Every new block is checked live against OWASP.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Web 应用代码（前端+后端），不碰基础设施配置、依赖供应链或已部署系统。它给建议。
limit_en: Web app code only (frontend+backend). No infra config, supply chain, or live systems. It advises; it doesn't auto-fix—you patch manually.
title_en: A security auditor beside you as you write web code
